analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is hovering at 63.1 in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram is improving to -104.2502 but remains in negative territory. A potential Lower High pattern is forming as the 5-day high is below the 20-day high. Trading volume is average, offering no directional conviction. With a stop loss of 1.3x ATR ($2,637.76), the distance to the swing support ($84,436.31) is only 1.2x, failing the 1.5 risk/reward ratio. Therefore, maintaining a neutral stance.
